resources.string: Notifications are off: you won\'t know when someone writes to you
This phone couldn\'t be registered for notifications
Your phone may hold back Chaggu notifications
Some phones close apps in the background to save battery, and messages then arrive late or not at all. In the app settings:
• Battery usage → allow “Background activity” and “Auto launch”.
• Battery → “Unrestricted”.\n• In Phone Master / App management, allow “Auto-start”.
• App launch → “Manage manually” and turn on all three switches.
• Battery → “Unrestricted”, and make sure Chaggu is not in “Sleeping apps”.
